findings.title: Direct actual-type owner construction bypasses real journal and private-root admission
findings.cause: _CatalogCopyStages has no guarded factory admission or independent actual journal/plan/root/ledger binding validation. catalog_import._copy_item accepts any object of this exact class, so exact-type dispatch alone is insufficient.

causal_cases.setup: Real current plan/ledger and real pinned native private descriptors; SimpleNamespace journal with no-op require_current/append and actual empty journal directory.

causal_cases.case: actual live journal but source-project private root
causal_cases.setup: Real retained_layout_journal, correct canonical plan binding and stored plan payload, real pinned directory under actual source_root, actual current plan+ledger.

findings.required_change: Require admitted factory provenance and validate the actual active journal/context, original FD/guard/budget, exact plan/header and private-root scope, plus original reserved shared ledger. Guard actual journal registration against reconstruction of an exact class with a no-op guard. An actual journal type alone does not fix source-root admission bypass.

findings.title: Journal per-file reader allowance can exceed original plan ceiling
findings.cause: Shared journal storage/files are precharged, but effective journal reader limit max(128KiB record limit, maximum_payload_bytes) is not intersected with original maximum_file_bytes before private creation.
findings.causal_case: Valid original64KiB-file plan and default1MiB journal payload budget are admitted. Grow actual same-inode journal/header.json to65537 bytes. Actual os.read accounting shows journal require_current reads all65537 bytes before rejecting changed record, exceeding original65536 ceiling.
findings.required_change: Refuse incompatible journal effective per-file allowance before any private journal/stage creation, or apply a sound original-ceiling-bound reader throughout. Preserve existing generic journal defaults for other owners.
findings.result: Part of2-failure admission cohort0.130s; this is a finite intersection violation, not an unbounded-reader claim.
